# Meeting notes

Edit the notes field, then explicitly Save note to add it to Projects. The first line becomes the title and remaining lines become the body. Save configuration retains the form as a reusable local template; export excludes saved instance configuration. Preview shows a synthetic meeting outline and disables saving.

Import tool.json through Widgets → Tools; this v2 package installs as a tab in Projects. Legacy v1 definitions remain under Widgets. Author: Open Sesame. License: MIT. Defaults and fixtures are public, synthetic package content. Keep private configuration in the installed instance. See [the authoring guide](../../../docs/tools.md) for validation, creation and submission requirements.
